OUR STORY & VISION

Personally Guided Safaris
Rooted in Deep Knowledge

Cotter Safaris was founded around a simple idea: to make the Kruger National Park accessible, comfortable, and deeply rewarding for small groups who want a personally guided safari experience.

The company is developed as a dedicated travel service, with an initial focus on carefully planned departures for Evergreen Val de Vie residents and similar retirement community groups who would love to visit Kruger but prefer not to manage the flights, transfers, accommodation, park logistics, and daily planning themselves.

Michael Cotter’s guiding career began in 2008. He completed FGASA Level 1 and Level 2, as well as his trails guide qualification, and later obtained his full trails guide qualification under the supervision of well-known SKS guide Bruce Lawson. Michael also acted as backup guide for Bruce during this period.

His extensive background includes anti-poaching work, lodge operations, ecological monitoring, wildlife tracking, game drives, guest hosting, and bush walks across Southern Africa’s premier wilderness areas — while always returning to his first loves: Kruger and the Kalahari.

Michael is also an accomplished wildlife photographer, with a background in forensic photography that developed into a deep love for photographing Africa’s wild places. Together with Bernette Cotter, he has travelled and photographed many iconic landscapes, including Namibia, Damaraland, Etosha, the Caprivi, Okavango Swamps, and the Kgalagadi.
